title: Showdown on the a-File
setup: Black is up a queen for a rook, but its king on a5 and queen on a8 are standing on the same file.
hint: Check the king along the line it shares with the queen, and see what is left when it steps aside.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is a skewer: the king stands in front and the queen behind. {{Ra1+}} checks the king on a5 down the a-file. Nothing can block, so the king has to leave the file, and after {{Kb6}}, {{Rxa8}} takes the queen.

In a pin the more valuable piece hides behind. In a skewer it stands in front, and when it moves, whatever is behind it falls.
